notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Demo Camera C900 versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are affected by a fictional insertion of sensitive information into log file issue. Version 1.2.0 contains the simulated fix; the separate 2.0.0 branch is not affected.

notes.title: Technical overview
notes.text: The fictional log export includes sensitive configuration values accessible to a low-privileged support account. A support account may read information not intended for that role. The issue is intentionally described without executable attack instructions or payloads.

notes.title: General recommendations
notes.text: For this demonstration, inventory the deployed version, restrict management access, back up configuration, and schedule the update to 1.2.0. Validate normal operation after updating. Disable support-account log exports and limit log access to trusted administrators.

notes.title: Are these real vulnerabilities?
notes.text: No. All products, issue identifiers, release versions, impact statements, and scores are synthetic. No real CVE identifiers are assigned. The example.com references illustrate the document structure and are not working support or download endpoints.

notes.title: Test data disclaimer
notes.text: This document is provided solely for testing CSAF processing and human-readable display. Do not treat it as evidence that any real product is vulnerable or use it as operational security guidance.

remediations.details: In this fictional scenario, update Demo Camera C900 from 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 during a maintenance window. Back up configuration, verify the installed version after the update, and confirm normal operation. The linked URL is a placeholder, not a download service.

restart_required.details: A simulated device or application restart is required after the update.

remediations.details: Disable support-account log exports and limit log access to trusted administrators. This reduces exposure but does not replace the fictional software fix.
Restrict service access to trusted networks, monitor unexpected service activity, and review administrative access until the simulated update is complete.
